#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a final 'Thank you for your attention' slide to Q4_financial_report.pptx.

Works directly on the OOXML package (no unpack step needed): it appends a new
slide part, wires it into presentation.xml, presentation.xml.rels and
[Content_Types].xml, then rewrites the archive in place.
"""
import os
import re
import sys
import zipfile
import xml.dom.minidom as minidom

PPTX_MAIN = "Q4_financial_report.pptx"
SLIDE_CT = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"
REL_SLIDE = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slide"
REL_LAYOUT = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slideLayout"
XML_DECL = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n'


def find_pptx():
    if os.path.exists(PPTX_MAIN):
        return PPTX_MAIN
    for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk("."):
        if dirpath.count(os.sep) >= 3:
            dirnames[:] = []
        for f in filenames:
            if f == PPTX_MAIN:
                return os.path.join(dirpath, f)
    return None


def main():
    src = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else find_pptx()
    if not src or not os.path.isfile(src):
        sys.exit("Q4_financial_report.pptx not found")

    with zipfile.ZipFile(src) as zf:
        data = {n: zf.read(n) for n in zf.namelist()}

    pres = data["ppt/presentation.xml"].decode("utf-8")
    rels = data["ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels"].decode("utf-8")
    ct = data["[Content_Types].xml"].decode("utf-8")

    # Next slide number (slide parts are numbered slide1.xml, slide2.xml, ...)
    nums = set()
    for name in data:
        m = re.search(r"ppt/slides/slide(\d+)\.xml", name)
        if m:
            nums.add(int(m.group(1)))
    if not nums:
        sys.exit("no slide parts found")
    new_num = max(nums) + 1

    # Unique sldId and relationship id
    ids = [int(x) for x in re.findall(r'<p:sldId id="(\d+)"', pres)]
    new_id = (max(ids) + 1) if ids else 256
    rids = [int(x) for x in re.findall(r'Id="rId(\d+)"', rels)]
    new_rid = "rId%d" % ((max(rids) + 1) if rids else 1)

    # Reuse the layout referenced by the current last slide, if available
    layout_target = "../slideLayouts/slideLayout1.xml"
    last_rels_key = "ppt/slides/_rels/slide%d.xml.rels" % max(nums)
    if last_rels_key in data:
        for relm in re.finditer(r"<Relationship\b[^>]*/?>", data[last_rels_key].decode("utf-8")):
            tag = relm.group(0)
            if 'Type="%s"' % REL_LAYOUT in tag:
                tm = re.search(r'Target="([^"]+)"', tag)
                if tm:
                    layout_target = tm.group(1)
                    break

    # Slide dimensions from presentation.xml (16:9 = 12192000 x 6858000)
    m = re.search(r'<p:sldSz\b[^>]*cx="(\d+)"[^>]*cy="(\d+)"', pres)
    cx, cy = (int(m.group(1)), int(m.group(2))) if m else (12192000, 6858000)

    # Theme font / dark color for the thank-you text
    font, color = "Calibri", "1F3864"
    theme_key = next((k for k in data if re.match(r"ppt/theme/theme\d+\.xml$", k)), None)
    if theme_key:
        tx = data[theme_key].decode("utf-8")
        mf = re.search(r'<a:majorFont>.*?<a:latin typeface="([^"]+)"', tx, re.S)
        if mf:
            font = mf.group(1)
        dc = re.search(r'<a:dk1>.*?<a:srgbClr val="([0-9A-Fa-f]{6})"', tx, re.S)
        if dc:
            color = dc.group(1)

    # Centered text box (75% wide, 20% tall)
    tw, th = int(cx * 0.75), int(cy * 0.20)
    ox, oy = int((cx - tw) / 2), int((cy - th) / 2)

    slide_xml = XML_DECL + """<p:sld xmlns:a="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" xmlns:r="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships" xmlns:p="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/presentationml/2006/main">
  <p:cSld>
    <p:spTree>
      <p:nvGrpSpPr>
        <p:cNvPr id="1" name=""/>
        <p:cNvGrpSpPr/>
        <p:nvPr/>
      </p:nvGrpSpPr>
      <p:grpSpPr>
        <a:xfrm>
          <a:off x="0" y="0"/>
          <a:ext cx="0" cy="0"/>
          <a:chOff x="0" y="0"/>
          <a:chExt cx="0" cy="0"/>
        </a:xfrm>
      </p:grpSpPr>
      <p:sp>
        <p:nvSpPr>
          <p:cNvPr id="2" name="ThankYou"/>
          <p:cNvSpPr/>
          <p:nvPr/>
        </p:nvSpPr>
        <p:spPr>
          <a:xfrm>
            <a:off x="%(ox)d" y="%(oy)d"/>
            <a:ext cx="%(tw)d" cy="%(th)d"/>
          </a:xfrm>
          <a:prstGeom prst="rect"><a:avLst/></a:prstGeom>
        </p:spPr>
        <p:txBody>
          <a:bodyPr wrap="square" anchor="ctr"><a:spAutoFit/></a:bodyPr>
          <a:lstStyle/>
          <a:p>
            <a:pPr algn="ctr"/>
            <a:r>
              <a:rPr lang="en-US" sz="4000" b="1">
                <a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val="%(color)s"/></a:solidFill>
                <a:latin typeface="%(font)s"/>
              </a:rPr>
              <a:t>Thank you for your attention</a:t>
            </a:r>
          </a:p>
        </p:txBody>
      </p:sp>
    </p:spTree>
  </p:cSld>
  <p:clrMapOvr><a:masterClrMapping/></p:clrMapOvr>
</p:sld>
""" % {"ox": ox, "oy": oy, "tw": tw, "th": th, "color": color, "font": font}

    slide_rels = XML_DECL + """<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">
  <Relationship Id="rId1" Type="%(REL_LAYOUT)s" Target="%(layout_target)s"/>
</Relationships>
""" % {"REL_LAYOUT": REL_LAYOUT, "layout_target": layout_target}

    # 1) presentation.xml: register the new slide in sldIdLst
    entry = '<p:sldId id="%d" r:id="%s"/>' % (new_id, new_rid)
    m = re.search(r"(<p:sldIdLst[^>]*>)(.*?)(</p:sldIdLst>)", pres, re.S)
    if m:
        pres = pres[:m.start()] + m.group(1) + m.group(2) + entry + m.group(3) + pres[m.end():]
    else:
        m = re.search(r"(<p:sldIdLst[^>]*)/>", pres)
        if not m:
            sys.exit("sldIdLst not found in presentation.xml")
        pres = pres[:m.start()] + m.group(1) + ">" + entry + "</p:sldIdLst>" + pres[m.end():]

    # 2) presentation.xml.rels: relationship for the new slide part
    rel_entry = '<Relationship Id="%s" Type="%s" Target="slides/slide%d.xml"/>' % (new_rid, REL_SLIDE, new_num)
    if "</Relationships>" in rels:
        rels = rels.replace("</Relationships>", rel_entry + "</Relationships>")
    else:
        m = re.search(r"(<Relationships[^>]*)/>", rels)
        if not m:
            sys.exit("Relationships root not found")
        rels = rels[:m.start()] + m.group(1) + ">" + rel_entry + "</Relationships>" + rels[m.end():]

    # 3) [Content_Types].xml: content type override for the new slide
    ct_entry = '<Override PartName="/ppt/slides/slide%d.xml" ContentType="%s"/>' % (new_num, SLIDE_CT)
    if "</Types>" in ct:
        ct = ct.replace("</Types>", ct_entry + "</Types>")
    else:
        m = re.search(r"(<Types[^>]*)/>", ct)
        if not m:
            sys.exit("Types root not found")
        ct = ct[:m.start()] + m.group(1) + ">" + ct_entry + "</Types>" + ct[m.end():]

    # 4) Rewrite the archive with the new/changed parts
    tmp = src + ".tmp"
    with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zf:
        zf.writestr("[Content_Types].xml", ct)
        for name in data:
            if name == "[Content_Types].xml":
                continue
            if name == "ppt/presentation.xml":
                zf.writestr(name, pres)
            elif name == "ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels":
                zf.writestr(name, rels)
            else:
                zf.writestr(name, data[name])
        zf.writestr("ppt/slides/slide%d.xml" % new_num, slide_xml)
        zf.writestr("ppt/slides/_rels/slide%d.xml.rels" % new_num, slide_rels)
    os.replace(tmp, src)

    # 5) Verify: zip integrity, all edited parts well-formed, text present
    with zipfile.ZipFile(src) as zf:
        bad = zf.testzip()
        if bad:
            sys.exit("zip integrity issue: %s" % bad)
        parts = ("ppt/presentation.xml", "ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels",
                 "[Content_Types].xml", "ppt/slides/slide%d.xml" % new_num,
                 "ppt/slides/_rels/slide%d.xml.rels" % new_num)
        for part in parts:
            minidom.parseString(zf.read(part))
        slide_text = zf.read("ppt/slides/slide%d.xml" % new_num).decode("utf-8")
        if "Thank you for your attention" not in slide_text:
            sys.exit("verification failed: text missing from new slide")

    print("OK: added final slide slide%d (sldId %d, %s) to %s; total slides: %d"
          % (new_num, new_id, new_rid, src, len(nums) + 1))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
